# 12-Week Post-MI Cardiac-Safe Fitness Programme

## Client Profile & Safety Parameters
- Age: 58 | 6 months post-MI | Cardiac rehab clearance obtained
- **HR ceiling: 115 bpm (70% age-predicted max)**
- **Intensity cap: Moderate only (RPE 4–6/10)**
- **Contraindications: No Valsalva, no maximal efforts, no straining**
- **Session structure: 3 days/week, non-consecutive**
- **Warm-up/cool-down: 5 minutes each, mandatory**

---

## Programme Overview

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation & Tolerance Building**
- Focus: Movement quality, HR monitoring, confidence-building
- 3 sessions/week: 35–40 minutes total

**Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Aerobic Base & Muscular Endurance**
- Focus: Sustained moderate intensity, light resistance, work capacity
- 3 sessions/week: 40–45 minutes total

**Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Consolidation & Functional Strength**
- Focus: Integrated movement patterns, modest load progression, independence
- 3 sessions/week: 45–50 minutes total

---

## PHASE 1: Foundation & Tolerance Building (Weeks 1–4)

### Session Structure
- **Warm-up:** 5 min easy walking/cycling
- **Main work:** 25–30 min mixed modality
- **Cool-down:** 5 min easy walking, breathing focus
- **HR monitoring:** Check at 5, 15, and 25 min marks; record in log

### Week 1

**Session 1A (Monday) – Treadmill & Upper Body Intro**
- Warm-up: 5 min walk, RPE 2–3
- Treadmill: 15 min continuous walk, 2.5–3.0 mph, flat, RPE 3–4 (target HR 100–110 bpm)
- Upper body (light dumbbells, 2–3 lb):
  - Dumbbell shoulder press (seated): 2 × 10 reps, slow tempo, RPE 2
  - Dumbbell bicep curl: 2 × 10 reps, RPE 2
  - Chest press machine (light): 2 × 10 reps, RPE 2
- Cool-down: 5 min walk, breathing cues
- **Total time: 38 min**

**Session 1B (Wednesday) – Stationary Bike & Core Intro**
- Warm-up: 5 min easy pedal, RPE 2
- Stationary bike: 15 min steady state, resistance 2–3, RPE 3–4 (target HR 100–110 bpm)
- Bodyweight/assisted core (no Valsalva):
  - Seated marching: 2 × 15 reps, RPE 1
  - Quadruped bird-dog (hold 2 sec): 2 × 8 each side, RPE 2
  - Supine glute bridge (feet on floor, light): 2 × 10 reps, RPE 2
  - Wall push-up (hands on wall, 45°): 2 × 8 reps, RPE 2
- Cool-down: 5 min walk
- **Total time: 38 min**

**Session 1C (Friday) – Elliptical & Lower Body Intro**
- Warm-up: 5 min easy walk, RPE 2
- Elliptical: 15 min, low resistance, RPE 3–4 (target HR 100–110 bpm)
- Lower body (bodyweight/light):
  - Assisted squat (hold rail, partial depth): 2 × 10 reps, RPE 2
  - Seated leg extension (light): 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2
  - Supine hamstring curl (light): 2 × 10 reps, RPE 2
  - Standing calf raise (hold rail): 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2
- Cool-down: 5 min walk
- **Total time: 38 min**

### Week 2

**Session 2A (Monday) – Treadmill & Upper Body**
- Warm-up: 5 min walk, RPE 2
- Treadmill: 18 min walk, 2.8–3.2 mph, flat, RPE 3–4 (target HR 105–115 bpm)
- Upper body (3–5 lb dumbbells):
  - Dumbbell shoulder press (seated): 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2–3
  - Dumbbell row (single arm, light): 2 × 10 each side, RPE 2–3
  - Chest press machine: 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2–3
  - Lat pulldown (light): 2 × 10 reps, RPE 2
- Cool-down: 5 min walk
- **Total time: 40 min**

**Session 2B (Wednesday) – Bike & Core**
- Warm-up: 5 min easy pedal, RPE 2
- Stationary bike: 18 min, resistance 3–4, RPE 3–4 (target HR 105–115 bpm)
- Core (no Valsalva):
  - Seated marching: 2 × 20 reps, RPE 1
  - Quadruped bird-dog: 2 × 10 each side, RPE 2
  - Supine glute bridge: 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2
  - Plank hold (wall-assisted, 10–15 sec): 2 × 1, RPE 2
  - Dead bug (light): 2 × 8 reps, RPE 2
- Cool-down: 5 min walk
- **Total time: 40 min**

**Session 2C (Friday) – Elliptical & Lower Body**
- Warm-up: 5 min walk, RPE 2
- Elliptical: 18 min, low–moderate resistance, RPE 3–4 (target HR 105–115 bpm)
- Lower body:
  - Assisted squat (partial): 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2–3
  - Seated leg extension: 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2–3
  - Supine hamstring curl: 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2–3
  - Standing calf raise: 2 × 15 reps, RPE 2
  - Seated hip abduction (light): 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2
- Cool-down: 5 min walk
- **Total time: 40 min**

### Week 3

**Session 3A (Monday) – Treadmill & Upper Body**
- Warm-up: 5 min walk, RPE 2
- Treadmill: 20 min walk, 3.0–3.3 mph, flat, RPE 3–4 (target HR 105–115 bpm)
- Upper body (5 lb dumbbells):
  - Dumbbell shoulder press (seated): 3 × 10 reps, RPE 3
  - Dumbbell row: 3 × 10 each side, RPE 3
  - Chest press machine: 3 × 10 reps, RPE 3
  - Lat pulldown: 2 × 12 reps, RPE 2–3
  - Dumbbell lateral raise (light): 2 × 10 reps, RPE 2
- Cool-down: 5 min walk
- **Total time: 42 min**

**Session 3B (Wednesday) – Bike & Core**
- Warm-up: 5 min easy pedal, RPE 2
- Stationary bike: 20 min, resistance 4–5, RPE 3–4 (target HR 105–115 bpm)
- Core:

### Week 4

**Session 4B (Wednesday) – Bike & Core**

Client has demonstrated tolerance and confidence. Aerobic work extends to 25–28 min; resistance increases modestly. Introduction of light circuit-style work (non-fatiguing) to build work capacity.
